Q5786.reason: A faith-based refusal of transfusion is a foreseeable consequence of the injury, so the driver’s negligence remains the legal cause and the estate recovers full wrongful death damages.

Q5253.reason: Executory interests are the nonvested grantee interests that must vest, if at all, within the perpetuities period and are the core target of the Rule Against Perpetuities.

Q5347.reason: In a 1–2 second maximal contraction, phosphocreatine stores transfer phosphate to ADP and thereby supply the energy used for cross-bridge force.
